title: Settings
description: Every runtime setting, with its type, default and environment variable.

<!-- Generated by `neon settings docs` from the settings registry. Do not edit: change the registry and regenerate. -->

Runtime settings can change while the server runs. Each takes its value from the first of
these that has one: its environment variable, its key under `settings` in `neon.yaml`, the
value saved in the database, its default. A setting set by its variable or in `neon.yaml` is
pinned. How they fit together is in [Configuration](/docs/self-hosting/configuration/).

`neon settings docs` writes this page from the server's settings registry, so the table
matches the code it was generated from.

| Key | Type | Default | Environment variable | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `instance.name` | string | `Neon Workspace` | `NEON_SETTINGS__INSTANCE__NAME` | The instance's name, shown in the app and returned by `GET /api/v1/meta`. |
